messages:
chloe: Hey all — first week here, quick access question. I'm trying to set up my access matrix for Console and FF work. Which groups/roles should I request for staging vs prod? I need admin panel access for staging and the ability to toggle feature flags to reproduce a customer bug, but I want to avoid overly broad prod perms. cc @ben
ben: Welcome! For most new hires: staging -> `console-staging-admin` (or staging-readonly if you don't need admin). Prod -> prefer `console-prod-readonly` + `prod-ff-operator` if you must flip flags. We avoid granting prod admin permanently. Use JIT for temporary admin (30m) when necessary.
lina: Add me on the request so People Ops can track approvals. Security requires manager sign-off + a short justification for prod roles. Use this template: `team, env, reason, duration, manager`
infra-bot: Automated reply: docs -> https://go/redwood/access-matrix. You can also run: `./scripts/request_access --env prod --role prod-ff-operator --duration 4h`
sam: +1 to Ben. If you'll be toggling FFs that affect customers, include `prod-ff-operator` and tag `#ff-changes` in the ticket so CS/PM get notified. Also add `platform-oncall` as an approver for emergency rollbacks. :thumbsup:
chloe: Thanks — one more: service accounts? For running integration tests against the Console API should I create a personal SA or use the team SA?
ben: Use the team service account (team-ml-ci). Personal SAs are discouraged for prod access. If you need ephemeral creds, platform can issue rotating tokens. I can add you to `team-ml-ci` once you confirm.
lina: Note for audits: all FF toggles are logged. If changes are customer-impacting, coordinate with CS and include the customer ticket ID in the request.
chloe: Confirmed — please add me to `team-ml-ci` and I'll file the infra-requests ticket with the template and manager approval. Filing now. Thanks!
ben: Sample request body you can paste into infra-requests:
```
team: ml-core
env: prod
roles: [prod-ff-operator, console-prod-readonly]
reason: investigate customer-1234 latency regression
duration: 4h
manager: sam
```
chloe: Filed the request and added @lina for approvals. Appreciate the quick help :)
